title: NILS review item
description: One thing the engine was not certain of, in a scope, with the evidence that raised it and the decision that closed it. Version 2 (Wave 4a section 10.2): a grouped question is one item of scope group with n members; a decision may be staged before it is committed; an acknowledgement records who accepted the item without a decision.

id.description: The item's row id in the registry it lives in.

kind.description: What was found: `<area>.<what>` for an engine stage, `<axis>:<reason>` for the classifier.

scope.description: What the item is about. A group is one question about a rule, an origin or a study, with its members in the registry.

status.description: Open until decided or acknowledged (accepted); staged while its decision waits for a commit; superseded when a later run asked again.

actor.description: Who decided it, as the registry names them; null while open.

created_at.description: When it was raised, ISO 8601 UTC.

decided_at.description: When it was decided, ISO 8601 UTC; null while open.

ref.description: What the scope names: `stack_id`, `series_id`, `study_id`, `subject_id`, `batch_id` or `run_id`, as the scope requires.

evidence.description: What the emitting stage found, structured, in the shape its kind describes; never a value the registry holds in confidence.

decision.description: What was decided, once it was: for a classifier kind, the axis, the value, who decided (`actor`, `author_kind` person, agent or model, `model_version`) and why. Since version 3, `actor_detail` says who acted for that principal.

actor_detail.description: Wave 4c: who acted for the principal named in `actor`. `kind` is `person`, `agent`, `model` or `absent`; an agent names itself, its model, its version and its conversation, and the role ceiling it ran under. Absent is its own value, so a person acting alone is never confused with a missing record.

members.description: For a grouped question, how many stacks it is about.

group_key.description: For a grouped question, what groups its members: kind|value|tier.

accepted_by.description: The principal who acknowledged the item without a decision (Wave 4a section 13.4), as user@node.
